connector.name: Ejentum MCP
connector.registryDescription: Reasoning, code, anti-deception, memory harness MCP tools. Stdio or HTTPS api.ejentum.com/mcp
connector.summary: Hosted at api.ejentum.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package ejentum-mcp. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the ejentum account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token with EJENTUM_API_KEY. Get one at https://ejentum.com/pricing (30-day free trial; Go or Super tier required for adaptive tools).

env.name: EJENTUM_API_KEY
env.description: Ejentum API key. Get one at https://ejentum.com/pricing (30-day free trial; Go or Super tier required for adaptive tools).
